content:
Animator

Handles entity visuals. Only for animated visuals (.ase with animation tags). Alternative: entity.animate {animationName},{loopMode} command.

Component Common

Schema

JSON
{
  "animator": {
    "triggers": {
      "animationName": {
        "frameTag": 0
      }
    }
  }
}

Description

The Animator component handles entity visuals for animated sprites. It is intended only for entities with animated visuals using .ase files that contain animation tags. As an alternative to using this component directly, you can use the entity.animate {animationName},{loopMode} command to trigger animations.

The component supports defining triggers that fire events at specific animation frames, allowing you to synchronize game logic with visual animations.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
triggersDictionary{string, Dictionary{string, int}}Defines events triggered at specific animation frames. The first dictionary keys are animation names, the second dictionary maps frame tags to frame numbers.

Events

animator.{animationName}.{frameTag}

Triggered when the specified frame is played during the animation.

animator.{animationName}.onEnd

Triggered when the animation finishes playing.

Example

JSON
{
  "animator": {
    "triggers": {
      "attack": {
        "hitFrame": 3,
        "windUp": 1
      },
      "walk": {
        "footstep": 2
      }
    }
  }
}
